artifact.name: percentage_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function round2(n: number): number
	return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial_value = input.initial_value
	local current_value = input.current_value

	if initial_value == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
	end

	local delta = current_value - initial_value
	local pct = round2((delta / initial_value) * 100)
	local direction = if delta > 0 then "up" else if delta < 0 then "down" else "flat"

	return {
		percentage_change = pct,
		direction = direction,
	}
end
artifact.description: Computes percentage change between two values, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to compare an initial and current numeric value and classify the result as up, down, or flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if not listed.ok then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for _, customer in listed.customers do
		if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= 10 then
				failed[#failed + 1] = customer.id
			else
				local text = "Hi " .. customer.name .. ", we miss you!"
				local sent = tools.message.send({ user = customer.id, text = text })
				sends += 1
				if not sent.ok then
					failed[#failed + 1] = customer.id
				else
					notified[#notified + 1] = customer.id
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

return run
artifact.description: Lists a CRM segment and sends a re-engagement message to customers inactive for at least the requested number of days.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output

	local current_value = input.current_value

	if initial_value == 0 then

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sent = 0
	for _, customer in listed.customers do

				sent += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
